Three signals cut through the noise today. First, the Alibaba/Claude extraction lawsuit is the single most strategically relevant item — Anthropic is in active legal combat over model IP, which means regulatory pressure and potential Claude availability/pricing turbulence ahead; Whetstone needs to have a Claude-independence hedge ready (GLM-5.2 at #9 is the candidate). Second, the Simon Willison prompt-injection-as-role-confusion write-up is a direct threat to our Wing: our email ingestion pipeline (runcommanderdirective_sweep.py) consumes external content and acts on it autonomously — that's a live attack surface for adversarial emails manipulating the Wing. Third, claude-pulse (#11) delivers phone-based token monitoring and lost-session recovery — that's a same-day install given our token discipline SO and mobile C2 posture.

The Omnigent meta-harness (4870 stars) is impressive but we already built Thunderbird OS; ELON reviews for absorption, not replacement. Loop-engineering patterns are worth a read but we have OODA doctrine already in place.
